_meta.description: Structural subgraph of Christopher Alexander's A Pattern Language (Oxford University Press, 1977) pattern DAG -- pattern numbers, names, and 'larger patterns' / 'smaller patterns' cross-references only. No copyrighted prose (Problem/Solution text) is reproduced here -- see README.md's own Reference section for where the real text lives (patternlanguage.com/apl/aplsample and the Cornell PDF mirror, citation only, never redistributed as a file).
_meta.scope: Every pattern this project has implemented as a generator (street-smarts-patterns) and/or an opinion (street-smarts-opinions), plus their immediate real neighbors in Alexander's own graph, as needed to source street-smarts-patterns::cascade_contracts::CASCADE_CONTRACTS.
_meta.direction: 'larger' = patterns that name THIS pattern as a smaller pattern they call for (this pattern is a part/detail of them). 'smaller' = patterns THIS pattern names as smaller patterns it calls for (this pattern decomposes into them). Both directions as literally listed on the cited source page(s) -- not inferred or reconstructed.
_meta.verification: Each pattern's larger/smaller lists were fetched from at least one of the two sources below; entries fetched from both are marked verified_by_two_sources. One real disagreement was found and excluded (a numbering conflict for 'Home Workshop', reported as both 57 and 157 across the two sources) -- see house_cluster's own note.
_meta.correction_2026-07-20: Patterns 29, 95, 96, and 108 were originally written into this file from unverified recall, not a real fetch (every fetch attempted for them at the time returned a registration wall or 404) -- a real lapse in this project's own citation discipline, caught and fixed the same day. Re-fetched for real via patternlanguage.cc: 29, 95, and 108's recalled data matched the genuine page closely; 96's 'larger' list was incomplete (missing 116, 99, 104) and has been corrected. 95's 'larger' list was previously a long fabricated list -- the real page only explicitly names a partial list before saying 'and many others' (it does not enumerate the rest), so 95's 'larger' here is now that confirmed partial list only, marked not exhaustive.
sources: https://patternlanguage.com/apl/apl{N}/apl{N}.htm (a direct-excerpt mirror; NOT the same as the aplsample/ path this project's own SourceCitation urls use, which returns 404 as of this writing)
